sources.entry: SATF - Shake a file while dragging it to convert, merge into a PDF, zip, or extract it from a radial menu under your cursor. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/tran-minh-khoi/SATF) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: SATF is a free, open-source radial menu for macOS and Windows that appears under your cursor when you shake a dragged file, letting you convert, edit, merge, zip, extract, or stash it locally.
summary.what_it_does: SATF lets you shake a file while dragging it to open a radial menu under the cursor, where you can drop it onto a target format or action. It converts images, PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, video and audio, with the availability of some conversions depending on platform and installed Office or add-on tools. It can rotate, resize, compress, shrink under a size target, strip location and camera info, or stack images, and it can merge several documents into one PDF or bundle files into one ZIP. Archives (zip, rar, 7z, tar, gz, bz2, xz) can be extracted, optionally using third-party archivers like The Unarchiver, Keka, 7-Zip or WinRAR. A floating Shelf collects files for later drag-out, copy, or share. The README states that all processing happens locally, with network access only for update checks and optional add-on downloads.
use_cases: convert a file to another format by dragging it
merge several PDFs or documents into one PDF
collect files from different folders in a tray
how_to_run: Download SATF-1.2.1.dmg (macOS 13+) or SATF-Setup-1.2.1.exe (Windows 10 2004+) from the Releases page
macOS: open the DMG and drag SATF into Applications
Windows: run SATF-Setup and click More info → Run anyway if SmartScreen warns
Build Windows app on a Mac: brew install makensis (needs .NET 10 SDK), then ./build-win.sh
notable: Shake-to-open radial menu placed under the cursor, with a Shelf tray for collecting files
Conversions run locally; no uploads, accounts, or analytics per README
Heavy tools like LibreOffice and FFmpeg download only when needed as add-ons
Native apps for both macOS (Swift) and Windows (C#/WPF) with English and Vietnamese UI
Can use existing archive apps such as The Unarchiver, Keka, 7-Zip, WinRAR
caveats: Windows build is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen shows a warning on install
Office-based conversions need Microsoft Office or the Office add-on (~300–350 MB); video/audio on Windows needs the ~115 MB add-on
Some formats are only available on one platform (e.g., AVIF/ICO on macOS output, DOCX output on Windows PDF/PPTX)
Building from source requires Xcode Command Line Tools or the .NET 10 SDK and NSIS
